title: 2025 Checkout Latency Study
text: The 2025 checkout latency study found that p95 latency fell from 820 ms to 610 ms after enabling database connection pooling. The study covered 14 days of production traffic.

title: Checkout Cache Review
text: In the same 2025 study period, the checkout cache hit rate rose from 72% to 91% after the product catalog cache TTL was extended to 10 minutes.

title: gRPC Migration Proposal
text: A proposal to migrate checkout to gRPC is under review. No measurements have been taken yet.

title: On-call Handbook
text: Pages for checkout are routed to the payments on-call rotation.
